title: Artemisia
summary: Raleigh names Artemisia in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Artemisia, the daughter of Lygdames, who furnished Gallies of Halycarnassus and the Islands adioyning, and commaunded them her selfe. The citie was not attached. A word before of Halycarnassus is a gap and was not filled. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
